items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: And the picture you saw with Ben Webster and Sonny and Blanton, that's the night that I gave a session, and invited everybody in town

ctx.x: And then she was also in 'Jump for Joy' wasn't she?

Yeah, she was in 'Jump for Joy'. That's when Blanton and I were really hanging out together, and earlier, I think I told you about the session, didn't I, with Slam Steward and Jimmy Blanton -- did I tell you about that?

Well, Slam and Pres were really good friends, you know, but Pres didn't know about Blanton, because Blanton and I hung together -- he was my friend. And the picture you saw with Ben Webster and Sonny and Blanton, that's the night that I gave a session, and invited everybody in town -- from the [Bell] Tavern; from all the clubs in town, all the performers,
